newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq says Kuwait detains, tortures Iraqi national.
newsitem.headline: Iraq says Kuwait detains, tortures Iraqi national.

text.p: Iraq on Monday accused Kuwaiti authorities of detaining and torturing an Iraqi national for allegedly spying for Baghdad.

"Riyad Obaid Rdan, 21,... was arrested by Kuwaiti authorities who were driving a pick-up car in the demilitarised zone on January 16 (1997) while he was attending his camels," said a statement by the Iraqi Foreign Ministry.

The statement carried by the official Iraqi News Agency said Rdan was suspected of spying for Iraq and was found with serious injuries near the border after he was jailed and tortured in Kuwait for 15 days.

The statement said Iraq protested to the U.N. Iraq-Kuwait Observer Mission, a 32-nation observer force that patrols a 15 km (nine mile)-wide demilitarised border strip set up in 1991 after Iraqi invasion troops were driven from Kuwait.
